prompt: Write a main method where the first argument is a command, upper or lower, applied to the remaining arguments joined with spaces; any other command prints 'unknown command'.
explanation: The convention of command-line tools is that args[0] selects a subcommand and the rest are its operands. Starting the join loop at index 1 skips the command itself, and appending the separator before every element except the first avoids stray spaces. Comparing the command with equals (never ==) routes to toUpperCase, toLowerCase, or the unknown-command message.
hints: args[0] is the command; the text to transform is args[1] through args[args.length - 1].
Join the remaining arguments by looping from i = 1 and appending a space before every element except the first.
Compare the command with equals("upper") / equals("lower") and call text.toUpperCase() or text.toLowerCase(); anything else prints the literal line unknown command.
